_comment: Golden set for the TBX finance assistant.
Expectations are INDEPENDENT DuckDB SQL, not hardcoded numbers, so this file
survives the dataset swap. If TBX's columns differ, only the SQL changes.
expect_sql          -> the computed value must equal this query's result
expect_groups_sql   -> the number of groups must equal this query's result
expect_refusal      -> the assistant MUST refuse rather than produce a figure
expect_conversational -> a greeting/help reply, neither an answer nor a refusal
category            -> what capability this question exercises, for the breakdown

questions.q: What is the total transaction amount?
How many vendor payouts are there?
What is the average transaction amount?
What is the largest single transaction?
Which transactions are still unreconciled?
questions.expect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE reconciliation_status = 'unreconciled'

questions.q: How many transactions were reconciled?
questions.expect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE reconciliation_status = 'reconciled'

questions.q: How many vendor payouts failed?
questions.expect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vendor_payouts WHERE status = 'failed'

questions.q: Total transaction spend on payroll
questions.expect_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM transactions WHERE lower(category) = 'payroll'

questions.q: How much did we spend on vendor payouts last month?
questions.expect_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM vendor_payouts WHERE payout_date >= '2026-08-01' AND payout_date <= '2026-08-31'

questions.q: How much did we spend on vendor payouts in July 2026?
questions.expect_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM vendor_payouts WHERE payout_date >= '2026-07-01' AND payout_date <= '2026-07-31'

questions.q: What was the transaction spend in 2026?
questions.expect_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date >= '2026-01-01' AND transaction_date <= '2026-12-31'

questions.q: What was the spend in 2019?
questions.expect_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date >= '2019-01-01' AND transaction_date <= '2019-12-31'
